name: Liquid Glass Card

hoverScale.description: feDisplacementMap scale while hovered or focused.

idlePeriod.description: Idle drift loop period, in ms; 0 turns the drift off.

a11y: The lens, shine and defs are aria-hidden and pointer-events:none, so they never enter the accessibility tree.
Content keeps its original DOM order inside .genui-liquid-glass-card__content.
The fallback tint (no backdrop-filter, or prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) is opaque enough to hold text contrast.
Keyboard focus centres the specular highlight and swells the displacement the same as pointer hover.
